policy.resolution_rule: Conflicting official submission deadlines cannot be reconciled by choosing the newer-looking page or by inferring OPEN from dates. The task remains IN_REVIEW until the final hash-pinned guide package or an explicit official correction establishes the controlling deadline and the remaining material fact classes.
